THAT, the Articles of Association of the Company be
amended so as to insert a new clause 66A which will read
as follows:
“The Board may determine that a general meeting may
be held entirely by electronic or other communication
facility that permits all those entitled to be present to
participate in the meeting. Any shareholder (entitled to
vote) participating at the meeting may vote by means of
the telephonic, electronic or other communication facility
that the Company has made available for that purpose.”

THAT, the Articles of Association of the Company be
amended by deleting Article 149 in its entirety.
